title: The Donkey in the Well (The Art of Stepping Up)
summary: Nasruddin's old donkey fell into an abandoned dry well. Unable to pull the heavy animal out, the villagers decided to bury the well with shovels of dirt to put it out of its misery...
keywords: the donkey in the well - wisdom
full_text:
Nasruddin's old donkey fell into an abandoned dry well. Unable to pull the heavy animal out, the villagers decided to bury the well with shovels of dirt to put it out of its misery.

As shovelfuls of earth rained down upon its back, the donkey cried out in distress. But soon it quieted down.

With every shovel of dirt that struck its back, the donkey shook the earth off and stepped upward on top of it!

Shovel by shovel, step by step, the earth piled higher beneath its hooves until, to the astonishment of the crowd, the triumphant beast stepped proudly out over the lip of the well and trotted away to graze!

Nasruddin smiled: "Life throws dirt upon your shoulders; do not let it bury you! Shake it off and step up!"
moral: Shake off the dirt cast upon you and use every hardship as a stepping stone.
